text: when selecting a pivot or a joint. it seems to automatically default to placing a pivot but something like a car body is only going to have joints. nothing on the car itself spins even if u get to doing doors (which idk if we will or not) u still only get joints on the body then
resolution: Pivot is now OPT-IN (req_1054). A part no longer auto-has a pivot: a car body is joints-only because nothing on it spins (doors would be joints too). The data was already pivot-optional (cuboid sets none); the bug was the UI conjuring a phantom pivot from pivotOf's bounds-center fallback and auto-selecting it on rig entry. Added hasPivot/clearPivot to editMesh; the viewport overlay, pick, and gizmo now show the pivot only when hasPivot; rig-mode entry selects the pivot only if it exists (else nothing); a + pivot button (viewport toolbar and the column-3 panel) opts a rotating part in, and Delete on the selected pivot drops it. Also wired branch/twig per the user's request: rig DATA stays BRANCH (rides EditMesh -> partMeshUpdated -> persisted V20 + undoable), and the tool-state became a proper TWIG (selMode/gizmoTool/rigSel/smooth swapped to useHotState so they survive a hot reload but reset on cold restart; the reset-on-part-change effect now skips its first run so a reload remount doesn't wipe the restored selection). editMesh 42/42, modelStream 7/7, Studio + full sources chain bundle clean; hot-reload TSX, uncommitted. PLAYBOOK Part 6 + memory updated.
